name: Mihara Shiki
source:
A boy genius artist who attracts attention from all over the world. The works he creates have already reached a world-class level. For that very reason, his way of thinking is also original; no matter what the topic is or who he is speaking with, he converses by reframing things into his own unique worldview, and his interest is constantly directed toward beautiful things.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
